boundary: This packet records release-specific automated evidence, manual product QA evidence, and source-governance posture.
A completed packet is release evidence only for the named release candidate, deck kind, and JLPT levels.
It does not replace Platinum, Obsidian, hosted security, source-access, release-trust, or attestation gates.

scope.notes: Copy this template to out/release-qa/release-qa-evidence.json and replace every pending entry with release-specific evidence.

manualEvidence.notes: Record exact APKG path, checksum, Anki version, platform, import result, and sampled cards.
Record managed stroke-order and audio provenance checks plus packaged media identity.
Record desktop Anki rendering review, field layout, examples, notes, and media rendering.
Record AnkiDroid or AnkiMobile review when layout/media behavior is in scope.
Record accessibility review command output and manual screen-reader or no-color/zoom findings.
Record sampled audio files, reading identity, clipping/noise findings, and any rejected media.

sourceGovernance.notes: When source evidence depth is incomplete, release posture relies on accepted GOV-SRC-001 residual risk plus proof that free/public expansion is paused and source-access-gap, manual-citation-only, NLP, generated TSV, or Obsidian compatibility views were not promoted into source truth.

knownBlockers: Replace this template blocker with an empty array before release-ready claims.
